name: Romina Power
biography: Romina Francesca Power (born October 2, 1951) is an American actress and singer born in Los Angeles, California. She is the daughter of Hollywood matinée idol Tyrone Power and actress Linda Christian. Romina Power was half of the music duo Al Bano and Romina Power, which gained popularity in many parts of the world during the 1980s.
